mentions.name: constraint.fyi
mentions.description: A constraint-tracking tool for Clues by Sam logic puzzles that goes beyond the game's color tags. It represents clues as Boolean formulas and checks whether a player's deductions and hypothetical scenarios are consistent without revealing the solution, supporting same/opposite suspect statuses, overlapping relationships, cardinality constraints (e.g. '2 of these 5 are criminal'), hypothetical branches, and clue provenance. Deliberately omits auto-solving individual variables to preserve the game's fun.
mentions.problem: In harder Clues by Sam puzzles, the built-in color tags aren't enough to represent everything you need to track: suspect status relationships, overlapping relationships, cardinality constraints, hypothetical branches, or where a clue came from.
mentions.audience: Puzzle players of Clues by Sam deduction puzzles who need to track complex clues beyond color tags
mentions.source_excerpt: I made https://constraint.fyi/ after getting frustrated on some of the harder Clues by Sam (https://cluesbysam.com/) puzzles for which the color tags aren't enough to represent everything you need to track: whether suspects have the same or opposite status, overlapping relationships, cardinality constraints (e.g. "2 of these 5 are criminal"), hypothetical branches, or where a clue came from.
mentions.author: reedlaw
